title: How a Sink P-Trap Protects Your Home
description: The P-trap installed beneath a sink serves a critical health and safety role in residential plumbing. Its curved shape is engineered to retain a small standing pool of water after every use. This standing water creates an airtight liquid seal between the living space and the sewer line, preventing harmful sewer gases, foul odors, and dangerous pathogens from backing up into the room. Gravity holds the water in the dip of the trap while incoming wastewater pushes the excess out. Proper alignment and correct depth maintain this essential barrier.
